verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents a full SDK API reference (tracing decorators, dataset/experiment APIs, prompt sync SDKs), OTLP-based trace ingestion, a CLI (phoenix-cli), and an official remote MCP endpoint that lets AI-native clients search/query/operate on projects, traces, datasets, experiments, and prompts—together constituting a documented, programmatically-drivable public API surface. The openapi.json probe returned 404s at standard paths, meaning there's no discoverable formal REST/OpenAPI spec, so the API surface is SDK/CLI/MCP-centric rather than a single canonical REST API. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/REST spec, independent third-party confirmation of API robustness.
